full_name: Tova Reich | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Tova Reich is the author of My Holocaust: A Novel (HarperCollins, 2007), The Jewish War: A Novel (Pantheon Books, 1995), Master of the Return (Harcourt Brace Jovanovich, 1988), and Mara: A Novel (Farrar, Straus and Giroux, 1978).
